requirement.description: The next_token function fails to correctly identify and return tokens for several edge cases including incomplete tokens, hexadecimal strings, and literal strings with nested parentheses. Some tests expect None to be returned for incomplete tokens but the function returns incorrect token types.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return tokens according to PDF syntax specifications. For incomplete tokens at the end of input, it should return the appropriate token type with the correct boundaries. For hexadecimal strings, it should properly parse content between < and > symbols. For literal strings, it should properly handle nested parentheses.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function incorrectly processes dictionary and array elements, particularly when handling references (integer 0 R patterns) and complex data types. It fails to properly recognize and convert reference objects to complex numbers as expected by the tests.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly parse PDF objects including dictionaries and arrays. It must properly handle reference objects represented as integer 0 R patterns and convert them to complex numbers. Dictionary values must be parsed correctly, including handling of nested structures, strings, and various data types.

requirement.description: The text_string function doesn't properly handle certain Unicode text encodings expected by the tests, particularly for UTF-16BE encoded strings and PDFDocEncoding strings.
requirement.contract: The text_string function must correctly decode PDF text strings according to PDF specifications. It should handle literal strings (with parentheses) and hexadecimal strings (with angle brackets) with proper escape sequence handling and character encoding conversion.

requirement.description: The next_token function has incorrect handling of comments and keyword detection, causing it to return wrong token types in some scenarios.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify comment tokens and properly distinguish between keywords and other identifiers. Comments should be recognized when starting with % and extend to the end of line.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function fails to correctly handle complex nested structures and boolean values when parsing dictionaries and arrays.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly parse nested dictionaries and arrays, handling boolean values (true/false keywords), and properly converting various data types to their Python equivalents.
